question: Can the published metric be reproduced under the same physical and evaluation model?
audience: Researchers assessing decoder failure across noise conditions
baseline: MWPM using exactly the same detector error model and held-out shots

settings.notes: Training settings are released example defaults, not a verified match to the final paper runs. Freeze circuit and fit convention before paper comparison.
settings.seed_note: The local smoke sampler is explicitly seeded. The released training dataset does not seed Stim; its seed only selects round length.

hypothesis: The registered metric can be matched under the original protocol; no predicted advantage in the qkp simulator is asserted.
decision_rule: Compare independently measured estimates and uncertainty with reported values or marked visual-reading ranges. A match is provisional until model, split and units are audited; missing code/data or imprecise estimates remain inconclusive. Do not tune on held-out test data.
compute: Smoke: CPU, one thread, small bounded input. Production: explicitly launch after resolving listed blockers; no full training is started by fetch/check.
uncertainty: Wilson intervals for independent Bernoulli counts; bootstrap trajectory/seed-level fits for lifetimes and thresholds. Use three independent training seeds for new training, reported separately.
procedure: Generate seeded heavy-hexagon Stim detector events with the author circuit. Train the released residual GRU on short sequences. Evaluate all decoders on shared held-out shots across durations through 300 rounds; fit the same parity-decay model and compute 1 - epsilon_GRU/epsilon_MWPM. Short-sequence validation accuracy alone is not the published metric.
blockers: Original experimental datasets are available on request.
Released example configuration must be reconciled against final paper training settings before a metric reproduction claim.
Full multi-duration evaluation and matched MWPM comparison adapter not yet implemented.
Author training script assumes distributed CUDA initialization and fixed 500k validation; a portable production launcher needs adaptation.
The author dataset seed selects round length but does not seed its Stim sampler; do not claim deterministic training.
raw_output_contract: See ../RESULTS.md. Save raw outcomes, checkpoint/config/source hashes, environment, seed and noise units.
